text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
Having been adopted as Mifuyu's pupil, {0} now
hones his swordsmanship under her watchful eye.
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}は、弟子入りしたミフユのもとで
剣術の鍛錬を積んでいた。

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: C'mon, that all you got? You're not even trying!
text_block_list.orig_text:
まだまだ！　
腰が入ってないわ！

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
No, no, no. Here, watch me.
You take this, and go like this, take aim... and thrust!
Then step back! These are the basics of the \"stick and move.\"
text_block_list.orig_text:
違う違う、
いい？　
ここを、
こうして……
狙いを定めて一点突破！
そしてすぐ後ろに下がる！　
このヒット＆アウェイが基本よ！

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: Good! That's it!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そう！　
いい感じね！

text_block_list.name: Townsman
text_block_list.text: Heeey, somebody, heeelp!
text_block_list.orig_text:
おーい、
誰か、
助けてくれーーーーー！

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Someone from the town is shouting and running this way.
What's going on?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あら。
大きな声を出しながら
街の人が走ってくるわ。
何かしら？

text_block_list.name: Townsman
text_block_list.text: *huff* *huff*
text_block_list.orig_text:
はあっ、
はあっ……

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: What's all the fuss?
text_block_list.orig_text: 何があったの？

text_block_list.name: Townsman
text_block_list.text:
Ya see, some kids were playing in the ruins of the old castle
when some monsters suddenly attacked. I got away,
but the kids are still back there!
text_block_list.orig_text:
それが、
廃墟になった古城で子供たちが遊んでたら……
魔物が突然襲ってきて、
子供たちが
古城に取り残されてしまったんだ！

text_block_list.name: Townsman
text_block_list.text:
Please help us! If ya think you can take the monsters, 
ya gotta get those kids outta there!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あんたたち頼む！　
腕に覚えがあるなら、
子供たちを
助け出してくれ！！

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: Okay. And if we help, how many rupies will you pay us?
choice_data_list: Uh, hey, don't you think that's a bit cold?
Wow, Teach, you never forget the bottom line!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そう。
助けたら、何ルピ出してくれるの？

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: I-I know that. I was just kidding.
text_block_list.orig_text:
わ、
わかってるわよ、
ちょっと言ってみただけ……

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: Come on, I didn't mean it...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ほ、
本気で言ってるわけじゃないわよ……

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
Understood. We'll save the kids—free of charge.
How many monsters are there? Knowing this in advance
will make the fight go much more smoothly.
text_block_list.orig_text:
わかったわ。
私たちが助けに行くわ。
無償で……
敵は何体ぐらい？　
効率的に倒すから
事前に教えてくれると
助かるわ。

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, I see...
Okay, let's get moving, {0}!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふむふむ、
なるほど……
よし、
古城に行くわよ、{0}くん！

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
So this is the old castle.
All right, {0}, time to put what I taught you to use!
Let's finish this nice and efficiently!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ここが古城ね……
さあ、
{0}くん、
早速実践よ！
効率的に倒していってね！

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: Hiyaaah! Let's go!
text_block_list.orig_text:
おりゃあああああああ！　
どけどけーーっ！

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: Gyaaarghhh!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──ギャオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: Uryaaah! More!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うりゃああああああ！　
のりこめーーーっ！

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: Gyaaarghhh!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──ギャオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
Now where the heck are those kids...?
Ah! There they are! They're clinging to that window ledge
up there to get away from the monsters!
text_block_list.orig_text:
子供たちはいったいどこに……
あっ！　
あそこにいたわ！
高窓のふちにしがみついて、
魔物から逃げてる！

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text: Waaah! Somebody heeelp!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うわああん！　
誰か助けてええええ！

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
I think we've pretty much cleared out all the monsters.
Hold on, kids! We'll be right there!
Okay, there we... go!
text_block_list.orig_text:
魔物も、
もうだいたい一掃したかしら？
キミたち、
今助けるわ！　
よいしょっ……
と。

text_block_list.name: Boy
text_block_list.text: Waaah! That was so scary!
text_block_list.orig_text:
わーん！　
こわかったよおお！

text_block_list.name: Girl
text_block_list.text: You're so strong and nice, lady! Thank you!
text_block_list.orig_text:
つよくてやさしいお姉ちゃんたち、
どうもありがとう！

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: Oh, you're welcome.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ど、
どういたしまして。

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: Heheh. I guess a freebie here and there doesn't hurt.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふふっ。
たまには、
こういうのもいいものね。

text_block_list.name: Townsman
text_block_list.text:
Thanks, lady!
Hmm... I don't have anything to pay you back with,
but the least I can do is mend those clothes of yours!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ありがとよ、
姉ちゃん！
その……
謝礼は出せなかったけど、
せめてその服ぐらいはこっちで修繕させてくれ！

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: ...My clothes?

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
Oh wow! That [i]is[/i] some serious rippage.
That's too bad, really.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああ。
ずいぶん派手に破れたわね。
やんなっちゃうわ、
もう……

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: But, well, I think it can wait a little longer.
text_block_list.orig_text:
でもまあ、
しばらくはこれでいいか。

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
I have another monster-hunting job lined up after this.
My clothes might get torn again, so it's just more efficient
to keep them like this for now.
choice_data_list: A girl should look more proper.
text_block_list.orig_text:
今日この後、
魔物討伐の依頼を受けてるから。
そこでもまた破れる可能性があるなら、
このままでいる方が効率的じゃない？

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: What? You're saying I should cover up with this?
text_block_list.orig_text:
えっ？　
これで隠せって？

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: Huh? What, you're lending me your cape?
text_block_list.orig_text:
え？　
って、
マントを貸してくれるって？

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text:
A girl should care more for her appearance, huh?
You know, I'd completely forgotten.
It's been so long since I thought any of that applied to me.
text_block_list.orig_text:
女の子がそんな恰好してちゃだめ……
か。
そういえば、
そうだったわね。
女の子という概念が自分にあったこと、
すっかり忘れてたわ。

text_block_list.name: Mifuyu
text_block_list.text: ...Thanks for reminding me, {0}.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ありがとうね。
{0}くん。

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
As Mifuyu recalled a forgotten side of herself,
her bond with {0} grew stronger.
text_block_list.orig_text:
自分の忘れていた一面を思い出したミフユと、
そんなミフユとの絆を強くした{0}だった。
